techniques.evidence: lib/foundry/extract/types.ts:271 Records engines per capability but executes single-generator extractions rather than paired cross-provider flip matrices.
lib/foundry/extract/prompts.ts:120 Generators receive unified prose prompts; there is no comparison across structured or typed channels.

lib/foundry/extract/performReplica.ts:71 Gating decisions like recipe adoption and early target termination rely on a single vision recognition call without a second independent grader.
lib/foundry/extract/vocabulary.ts:65 has_text is placed first as the veto in the schema but is merely logged as text in performReplica and ignored during scoring and recipe adoption.
lib/foundry/extract/vocabulary.ts:87 Requires fifteen fields on readback and seventeen on critique, exceeding the seven-field budget without short-circuiting on the initial veto field.

pairs.registryProposal: When an unconditional fail criterion (like has_text) is added to a schema, the standard should emphasize requiring the evaluation harness to short-circuit candidate selection and round settlement, preventing harnesses from declaring a veto field that is merely logged while un-vetoed scores drive adoption.
